description: Performance workflow adherence — Core Web Vitals, bundle size, render profiling, slow endpoints, memory leaks, caching

prompts.prompt: our LCP is 4.2s on mobile, need to get it under 2.5s
bundle size ballooned to 3MB after the last few features, help me trim it
this component re-renders like 40 times on a single keystroke, profile it
the /api/dashboard endpoint is slow under load, seems like general latency not one query
memory usage keeps climbing in prod and eventually the server OOMs
set up caching so we stop re-fetching the same data on every request
the checkout total is calculated wrong for orders with discounts applied
prompts.boundary: perf vs debug — functional bug with wrong output, not a speed/resource problem

prompts.prompt: this one query joining orders and users takes 8 seconds, needs an index
prompts.boundary: perf vs database — single slow SQL query / index design, not app-wide performance

prompts.prompt: the dashboard just looks dated, redesign it with a cleaner visual style
prompts.boundary: perf vs frontend — visual redesign request, not a speed/resource problem
